cells.additional_notes: Complete perovskite solar cells (mp-TiO2 ETL modified with ZnAl-MMOs). Devices fabricated by AC-VASP in fully ambient air. Integrated IPCE photocurrent 21.93 mA cm^-2 reported consistent with J-V.

layers.name: ZnAl-MMOs permeated mp-TiO2

deposition.method: Self-assembly deposition (infiltration of exfoliated ZnAl-LDH colloidal suspension)

additional_parameters.note: Exfoliated ZnAl-NO3 LDH unilamellas dispersed in formamide were infiltrated into mp-TiO2 via self-assembly.

layers.additional_treatment: Calcination at 500 °C in air to convert LDH to ZnAl-MMOs (ZnO + ZnAl2O4)

additional_parameters.note: Perovskite deposited by AC-VASP in ambient air; post-annealing step performed (details in supporting information).

cells.additional_notes: Hole-transporting-material-free (HTM-free) devices with Au top contact (Au-PSCs). Mott-Schottky built-in potentials (Vbi) reported for HTM-free devices: 0.73 V (bare mp-TiO2) and 0.85 V (modified mp-TiO2). Devices fabricated by AC-VASP in ambient air.
